q: This is the boy ___ won the race.
This is the book ___ I bought yesterday.
The person ___ car was stolen called the police.
The town ___ I was born is very small.
The girl ___ sits next to me is very kind.
The movie ___ we watched was exciting.

a: The teacher who helped me was very kind.
choices: The teacher who helped me was very kind.
The teacher which helped me was kind.
The teacher where helped me was kind.
The teacher whose helped me was kind.

a: The park where we played was crowded.
choices: The park where we played was crowded.
The park who we played was crowded.
The park whose we played was crowded.
The park where was crowded we played.

q: What does this mean? “The boy whose bike was stolen called his father.”
choices: The boy stole his father's bike.

q: Choose the sentence with the same meaning. “I met a girl. She speaks three languages.”
a: I met a girl who speaks three languages.
choices: I met a girl who speaks three languages.
I met a girl which speaks three languages.
I met a girl where speaks three languages.
I met a girl whose speaks three languages.
